title: The owner's sixth notes: beacons over the lost rockets after the landing, the seat hand-over that backs out and lights the next mount, a vignette in the sentry optics, Tab through the views, the Quiver's round always bursts, a slower heavier mortar from its barrel, a firmer stuck-hull ease, fewer stronger sentries, upgrade gains in the build menu, the plasma costs biomass, the shield only at the solar array
context: Owner, 2026-10-02 (tempo): 1) after the player gets the camera, highlight where other rockets mislanded, a sense of side mission; 2) Rotor to Quiver should zoom out of the Rotor, highlight the Quiver, enter its POV; 3) a small black vignette in the Rotor and Quiver POV; 4) TAB cycles the available views; 5) Quiver: AOE even on a missed target, explosion and dust even on a miss; 6) mortar: lower rate, bigger missile, bigger explosion and AOE; 7) the tank still gets stuck in small corridors; 8) towers harder to build, fewer spots but more powerful, or limited availability; 9) mortar rounds fire from the pedestal, should leave the barrel; 10) a sense of what sentry upgrades mean; 11) the tank's plasma costs biomass; 12) relays giving free shields is too OP, shields rechargeable only at the solar array; 13) still thinking: a maximum range for building towers.
outcome: 1) src/fx/site-beacons.js: a pulsing light column and ground ring over each first-wave landing site from the first free camera after the landing, gone once the site is visited; Isao's sites_seen. 2) The take-control shot had stopped playing for any hand-over (shots end every frame in a seat, and the seat's pose outranked the shot); both are exempted for takeControl, and takeControlPose takes the previous seat's camera: it backs out up and away for a third of a 4.4 s shot, then swings round the new mount, which carries a thin pulsing ring (src/fx/seat-highlight.js). 3) #seat-vignette under the seat panel, hidden on the map and in the gunship. 4) Tab / Shift+Tab click the next shown, enabled button of the views strip (src/fx/story-views.js). 5) A TALON landing hurts every body within 1.2 cells at half its damage, hit or miss, and a miss raises rock dust (QUIVER_SPLASH). 6) Mortar rate 0.9 -> 0.5, damage 0.133 -> 0.3, splash 1.5 -> 2.2 cells, shell mesh x1.6, mortar.shell burst 0.62 -> 0.95. 9) The shell starts at the muzzle and its height eases from the muzzle's to the burst height over the flight. 7) HULL_STUCK 0.45/0.6/0.15/1.4 -> 0.25/0.35/0.3/2.4 (sooner, firmer; not measured in a real corridor). 8) STORY_SENTRIES: Isao keeps at most 10 sentries (standing plus ordered), every sentry hits 1.4x in the story. 13) STORY_SENTRIES.buildCells exists and is null (off) while the owner weighs it. 10) The build menu's tower centre lists the next tier's gains (dmg, range, rate, blast). 11) The story's plasma burns 3 kg a second; dry, the trigger refuses with PLASMA DRY. 12) In the story Relays no longer charge the shield and the Stålheart's pad no longer charges it: only the solar array does.
alternatives: A wider corridor clearance for the hull instead of a firmer ease: the hull's footprint guards against clipping walls the owner asked to fix before
Removing Relays' shield effect everywhere: the classic board keeps its rules; the story is where the owner plays
Making 8 'fewer spots' rather than a cap: the story's spots are every rock cell; a cap is one number the owner can move
evidence: scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --round6 (artifacts/browser/round6-rotor.png beacons, round6-rotor-vignette.png, round6-quiver-handover-out.png and -in.png, Tab and the plasma's biomass)
